title: Cohen-Lenstra class-group distributions for quadratic number fields
exact_target: Do odd-primary class groups of quadratic number fields follow the exact automorphism-weighted distributions predicted by Cohen and Lenstra?

sources.citation: B. Alberts, Cohen-Lenstra Moments for Some Nonabelian Groups, JTNB 32 (2020), 631-664; normalization identity in P. Majumder, arXiv:1407.3066v1.
